title: Countable sequentially dense families of test forms supported in a fixed compact set
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P (= Eucl P) be an arbitrary set and let K ⊆ ℝ^P be compact with K ⊆ U. Then there is a countable set E ⊆ D^k(U) (= TestFormOn U k: C^∞ forms ℝ^P → Covector (Eucl P) k with compact support and tsupport ⊆ U) with the following property. For every ω ∈ D^k(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ K there is a sequence (e_l)_{l∈ℕ} with e_l ∈ E for all l and TestFormOnConverges e ω. That is, there is a compact K' ⊆ U with tsupport e_l ⊆ K' for every l and tsupport ω ⊆ K', and for every i ∈ ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ i e_l → iteratedFDeriv ℝ i ω uniformly on K' as l → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U K : Set (Eucl P)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ E : Set (TestFormOn U k), E.Countable ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) ⊆ K → ∃ e : ℕ → TestFormOn U k, (∀ l, e l ∈ E) ∧ TestFormOnConverges e ω
